title: Sanger Tree of Life Sample Homogenisation: Sponge Squeezing
author: Elizabeth Sinclair
materials: Prepare all necessary equipment prior to starting and place any applicable items (e.g. cold blocks, tools) onto dry ice.

steps.title: Weigh Sponge Tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh 150–200 mg of selected flash frozen sponge tissue on a cold block on dry ice.

substeps.instruction: Transfer tissue into a fresh 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Return tube to the cold rack.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Squeezing
steps.instruction: Move one prepared sample onto a petri dish placed on the lab bench.

steps.title: First Lysis and Squeezing
steps.instruction: Extract cellular contents from the sponge tissue using lysis buffer and mechanical squeezing.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of prepared lysis buffer directly onto the sponge tissue in the petri dish to soak the sample.
Carefully slice the tissue into smaller sections and pull apart the skeleton using sterile forceps and a scalpel (use more cuts/pulling for fibrous tissue).
Tilt the petri dish at an angle.
Use wide forceps to squeeze the sponge tissue for 5–8 minutes (duration may vary by tissue type) to expel cellular contents into the buffer.
Optionally use the scalpel to press tissue against the sides or bottom of the dish.

steps.title: Collect First Extract
steps.instruction: Collect the lysis buffer (~2 mL) using a wide-bore P1000 pipette tip and transfer it into the original 2 mL microcentrifuge tube; label this tube 'A'.

steps.title: Second Lysis and Squeezing
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction process on the remaining tissue.

substeps.instruction: Add a further 2 mL of prepared lysis buffer directly onto the remaining sponge tissue pieces.
Repeat the squeezing technique described in the first extraction.

steps.title: Collect Second Extract
steps.instruction: Collect the lysis buffer (~2 mL) using a wide-bore P1000 pipette tip and transfer it into a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube; label this tube 'B'.

steps.title: Process Remaining Samples
steps.instruction: Repeat the steps for all sponge tissue samples until each has two 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes labelled 'A' and 'B'.

steps.title: Initial Cell Pelleting
steps.instruction: Centrifuge all tubes at 10,000 g for 1 minute at room temperature to pellet the cells.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant from Tube A
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant from tube 'A' using a standard P1000 pipette tip, leaving 10-20 µL on the pellet.

steps.title: Re-pellet Tube A
steps.instruction: Centrifuge all remaining 'A' tubes at 10,000 g for 1 minute at room temperature to re-pellet the cells.

steps.title: Combine Tube B into Tube A
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell pellet from tube 'B' into the matching tube 'A'.

substeps.instruction: Use a wide-bore P1000 pipette tip to remove and discard 1 mL of supernatant from tube 'B'.
Using the same tip, gently resuspend the pellet using the remaining supernatant.
Transfer the resuspended pellet into matching tube 'A'.

steps.title: Final Supernatant Removal
steps.instruction: Carefully remove all remaining supernatant from tubes labelled 'A' using a standard P1000 pipette tip and discard into a waste bottle, leaving only the pellet.
